summary: Full backend+frontend testing of the /api/track/access flow. Backend pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_track_access.py, 9 tests) 100% PASS: new visitor (mobile UA, desktop UA), dedupe by visitor_id within 30min (returns skipped:'duplicate'), /donaspainel path skipped (returns skipped:'admin'), admin login (donas/Seinao10@@) returns token, KPI 'acessos' increments after new POST, funnel-devices reflects mobile+desktop counts (Acessos ao site row: mobile 1->2, desktop 5->6), inicio.html served with CSP meta containing connect-src 'self' and tracker script that reads/sets pf_visitor_id in localStorage and posts to /api/track/access. Frontend Playwright: opening https://profmat.preview.emergentagent.com/ (inicio.html) fires exactly 1 POST /api/track/access -> 200; localStorage 'pf_visitor_id' created (e.g. v-mu8djee8-...); reloading the tab keeps posting once but backend returns {ok:true, skipped:'duplicate'} (verified via manual fetch reusing same vid); navigating to /candidato and /termos.html triggers 0 tracking POSTs. Admin panel /donaspainel login OK, dashboard KPI card 'ACESSOS' shows 17 and 'Funil de conversão' lists 'Acessos ao site 17' with mobile/desktop breakdown in ORIGEM POR DISPOSITIVO section; 'Atividade em tempo real' lists 'Novo acesso desktop/mobile' events.
seed_data_creation: Test visitor_ids created via pytest: qa-mobile-* and qa-desktop-* (dedup docs in 'accesses' collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoint POST /api/track/access (public, no auth). Body: {page,user_agent,extra:{visitor_id}}. Dedup: 30min by visitor_id (fallback IP+device). Returns {ok:true} or {ok:true, skipped:'duplicate'|'admin'}. KPIs: GET /api/admin/dashboard/kpis field 'acessos' (int). Funnel: GET /api/admin/dashboard/funnel-devices returns list of stages with {label,mobile,desktop}; 'Acessos ao site' is the first row. inicio.html script at /app/frontend/public/inicio.html manages pf_visitor_id in localStorage.
